transfer_checks.rule: Verify absence and reread repairs chronologically
cases: A probability law appears in the preceding paragraph: withdraw absence; do not add it again.
A newly moved induction preview mentions an index before its role: define the role or move the preview.
transfer_checks.reject: A distant later definition can leave a real sequencing cost; do not dismiss that cost merely because a whole-document search finds the word.

transfer_checks.rule: Operational parameter, branch and domain completeness
cases: A Monte Carlo error target requires an admissible finite trial count, not only asymptotic complexity.
An iterative approximation needs a defined output when it terminates before a sampled observation time.
transfer_checks.reject: A resource-only theorem that does not prescribe an executable procedure need not expose every implementation constant.

cases: A deterministic bound transfers to an average only after the averaging identity is supplied.
A fixed-depth limit does not become a varying-depth theorem by replacing the depth symbol.
transfer_checks.reject: Routine renaming of a bound variable in an uninterrupted proof needs no new interface.

cases: A formal claim appendix opens with current statement coverage, then links dated checker history.
A replication supplement opens with the current dataset/calibration and routes older runs to history.
transfer_checks.reject: An account whose research question is historical development may legitimately lead chronologically.

cases: A weighted-average exercise distinguishes recognition of the formula from executing a changed-weight calculation.
An induction task distinguishes checking three sums from reconstructing the universal induction step.
transfer_checks.reject: A survey promising orientation needs no proof-reconstruction exam, and an expert needs no remedial examples.

cases: A simulated reader has inherited a focus brief: preserve that exposure rather than relabel as blind.
A human gives an assisted second answer: retain the original separately from the successful reconstruction.
transfer_checks.reject: A retrospective source index remains useful as indexing; reject only the claim that it proves contemporaneous comprehension.

cases: An abstract fixed-parameter statement is traced to its fixed-parameter proof without borrowing uniformity.
A theorem quoted separately retains original credit and identifies locally explicit constants.
transfer_checks.reject: Routine consequences need not repeat full provenance, and a commit-only change does not itself prove changed source bytes.

transfer_checks.rule: Layout and metrics follow reader operation
cases: A definition lead-in remains with its list across a page boundary.
A verification appendix retains necessary status vocabulary even when the teaching body uses less.
transfer_checks.reject: Long proofs may break with clear continuation; no universal frequency threshold or all-prose table replacement is imposed.

transfer_evidence: Author-executed editorial transfer checks, not observed human learning or general theorem certification.
rejected_overextensions: Mandatory clean-output implementation when retained workspace suffices
Universal paragraph length or lexical-frequency acceptance thresholds
Treating a whole-paper index as a contemporaneous independent human study
Appending every reviewer microtask instead of consolidating repairs
New doctrine copies in ai_workflow when public lean-exposition owns the method
